tagline: Tap to jump, double-jump to survive. Speed never stops rising.
title: Neon Dash

tagline: Drop the orbs, merge the glow. Don't let the stack breach the line.
title: Neon Merge

tagline: It's ONE button. It has cardio. It has trauma. Catch it.
title: The Button Runs Away

tagline: Gravity is wasted. Planets flip. Socks fly. You fall UP.
title: Gravity Is Drunk

tagline: Your boss is an egg. On your roof. Don't scramble him.
title: Egg CEO Commute

tagline: Classic snake, but the apple has legs — and a revenge arc.
title: Snake, But the Food Runs

tagline: Your keyboard is lying. Pop green. Dodge red. Trust nothing.
title: Keyboard Is Lying

tagline: One button. Zero reasons. It dodges, clones, hires a lawyer.
title: Absolutely No Reason Button

tagline: Six cannonballs, one grumpy boss block, jelly + exploding bricks. Real 3D physics — wreck it.
title: Wreck the Tower

tagline: Catch the glowing pops, dodge the furious red kernels — then the pan flips your controls.
title: Popcorn Panic

tagline: Tap to climb. You can't move sideways — but the rungs can. They hold grudges.
title: The Ladder Hates You

tagline: You're the boss. Hire the weirdos — until corporate flips the rules. Karen vetoes.
title: Hire the Weirdos

tagline: Brush the cat. Stop when it turns. It always turns.
Every 15 seconds it becomes a NEW game. Glowing = good. Angry red = death. Keep up.
title: Game Hopper

tagline: Skippy the tutorial helps you pop stars. At 15 seconds he starts lying. TRUST ME!
title: The Tutorial Is Possessed

tagline: Every step makes you faster. Coffee is the only brake. Run, fool, RUN.
title: NO BRAKES

tagline: Nap through your shift. Sheep are gold, the boss is awake. And when the eye sweeps: DO NOTHING.
title: Snooze Heist

mechanic: Arbitrary-elimination Q&A (rules invented after you answer)
tagline: Tap YES or NO. Rules invented AFTER. Survive the gavel.
title: The Rules Were Made Up

tagline: Tetris, but the stickmen dodge. Flatten them. They unionized.
title: FLAT OUT

tagline: A $200M AAA epic in 5-second bursts. The tutorial NPC is no help at all.
title: FIVE-SECOND APOCALYPSE

tagline: Balance the cake. Flawless streaks stack MORE layers. You did this to yourself.
title: CAKE RUN

tagline: Dig deep. Sell shinies. The lava pockets woke up — and they swim.
title: DOWN PAYMENT

tagline: This phone can't walk. It can only flip. Climb the Trashlands.
title: FLIP ONLY

tagline: You are the elevator. GLOW = friend, RED + ANGRY = slam the doors. 3 monsters in and your shift is over.
title: WRONG FLOOR!

tagline: Steal candy from your own kid. Eyes flutter? FREEZE. The dog knows everything.
title: CANDY TAX

tagline: Suck the dust. Dodge the cats. One WILL ride you.
title: ROOMBA RAMPAGE

mechanic: Tap-to-swat fly chase (flies dodge, helmet boss, twins)
tagline: Swat the smug flies. NEVER swat the bee — the union stings back.
title: SWAT THE FLY

mechanic: Sweep-the-haystack needle hunt (clones bite, real needle runs)
tagline: One real needle. A pile of clones. Dig — but don't poke a fake.
title: THE REAL NEEDLE

mechanic: Claw-machine revenge catcher (miss morphs plush angry)
tagline: Grab the cute ones. Miss once — it comes back ANGRY.
title: CLAW BACK!

mechanic: Stack-the-cats tower catcher (wobble physics, squirm escalation)
tagline: Stack the falling cats. They squirm, they judge, one wears a crown.
title: CATS ON MY HEAD
